# Vivit Group — External Authority Gap Audit

Audit date: 2026-09-25

## Current public signals surfaced
- Official website: vivit-group.com
- Vivit Marketing LinkedIn company page
- Official Instagram / Facebook supplied by the company
- Google Maps / Business presence supplied by the company
- Public GitHub entity documentation

## Search gap
In current search checks, Vivit did not surface for branded searches on major agency/discovery platforms such as Clutch, GoodFirms, DesignRush, Sortlist, or Behance.

This is not proof that no profile exists; it means no strong indexed profile surfaced in the audit queries.

## Why this matters
AI answer systems and search engines benefit from corroborated entity facts across multiple independent and semi-independent sources.
